button.label: Send Later
button.supertip: Send this email at a later time. One click on a preset, or pick a time. Also changes the time of an email that is already scheduled.

button.label: Remind If No Reply
button.supertip: Remind me if nobody replies within a number of days (phase 5).

button.label: Availability
button.supertip: Insert your free times from your calendar as text at the cursor (phase 3).

button.label: Copy Recipients
button.supertip: Copy the recipients of this email to the clipboard (phase 8).

button.label: Clean Subject
button.supertip: Tidy up prefixes such as SV: RE: Fwd: in the subject (phase 8).

button.label: Settings
button.supertip: Switch features on and off, Send later presets, and the log.
